parameters.query:
SELECT c.code AS client_code, j.id AS job_id, j.client_id, j.unique_key, j.payload_json, j.priority
FROM claim_next_job('wf06', 900, 'CONTENT_FACTORY') j
LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = j.client_id

SELECT b.id AS brief_id, b.canonical_angle,
       COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('field_key', cl.field_key,
          'claim_text', cl.claim_text)) FILTER (WHERE cl.id IS NOT NULL),
          '[]'::jsonb) AS verified_claims,
       e.canonical_name AS entity_name
FROM content_briefs b
LEFT JOIN intents i ON i.id = b.intent_id
LEFT JOIN entities e ON e.id = b.target_entity_id
LEFT JOIN claims cl ON cl.entity_id = b.target_entity_id
      AND cl.id = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(b.required_claim_ids)::uuid))
      AND cl.verification = 'VERIFIED'
WHERE b.id = $1::uuid
GROUP BY b.id, b.canonical_angle, e.canonical_name
